body:
Fixes the sea-ice `TriadScheme` Coriolis acceleration in x, which no longer matches Oceananigans.

[CliMA/Oceananigans.jl#6096](https://github.com/CliMA/Oceananigans.jl/pull/6096) (released in Oceananigans 0.114.0) swapped the triads that multiply `v(i, j)` and `v(i, j+1)` in `x_f_cross_U` for the `TriadScheme`:

```julia
𝒯⁻⁻(i, j, k, grid, coriolis) * masked_Ay_qᶜᶠᶜ(i, j,   k, grid, U[2]) +
𝒯⁻⁺(i, j, k, grid, coriolis) * masked_Ay_qᶜᶠᶜ(i, j+1, k, grid, U[2])
```

ClimaSeaIce's `x_f_cross_U_2D` still had the old pairing (`𝒯⁻⁺` with `v(i, j)` and `𝒯⁻⁻` with `v(i, j+1)`). This PR swaps them to match. `y_f_cross_U_2D` already matched.

`test/test_vertical_grid_invariance.jl` checks that the two-dimensional operators reproduce Oceananigans' on a grid with uniform Δz, and it has been failing on `main` (194 of 4000 checks, all TriadScheme x). CI didn't catch it because the `vertical_grid` test group had no CI job, so this PR also adds one. With the fix, the group passes locally on Oceananigans 0.114.1.

This is independent of #190 (Oceananigans 0.116) and merges cleanly with it in either order.

title: Match Oceananigans' triad pairing in the sea-ice x Coriolis term
